sourceText: Analyze the supplied story-aware dynamic validation execution plan and implement the complete layered validate capability in the project with no omissions.
normalizedOutcome: A user can run validation and receive complete inventory accounting, deterministic execute/reuse/unverified selection, signed receipts and manifests, safe scheduling and sharding, and fail-closed dynamic TEST authority with full-plan fallback.
acceptanceClaim: The B-45a0 implementation passes its requirement-specific replay, fault-injection, mutation, scheduling, sharding, authority, and full-suite evidence with zero unverified or undeclared inputs.
